title: F.22 — Schema verification + rollback test (full forward+down+forward)
description: Full S1 verification gate. Run all S1 migrations forward, capture db/schema.rb diff, run db:rollback STEP=22 to reverse all, run db:migrate again to re-apply. Confirm bin/ci passes after each forward run. Per S1 §G dry-run procedure.
design: Procedure: bin/rails db:reset && bin/rails db:migrate && cp db/schema.rb /tmp/schema-after.rb && bin/rails db:rollback STEP=22 && bin/rails db:migrate && diff db/schema.rb /tmp/schema-after.rb (should match) && bin/ci.
acceptance_criteria: Forward migration clean; rollback clean; re-apply matches; bin/ci passes; final schema diff committed alongside the migration files.

title: F.20 — Widen cards.id PK from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P9 §A.2: the keystone migration. cards.id becomes Beads issue id (string). Must run AFTER all child FK columns are widened (F.8-F.19) so PK type matches FK type at re-add time (F.21).
design: Migration: WidenCardsIdPk. change_column :cards, :id, :string, limit: 255, null: false; ensure PK constraint is preserved. Re-create any indexes that depend on id type. Down: change back to :uuid.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; cards.id is varchar(255) PK; all child FK columns are compatible (already widened F.8-F.19); rollback works in clean install.

title: S5 F.11 — Close fizzy-6iv placeholder on S5 lock (one-line bd close)
description: Tracking bead for the manual close of the S2-dispatched cross-spec placeholder fizzy-6iv when S5 ratifies 3-of-3. Per spec §K and brief DoD. Execution is MANUAL on lock commit; this bead is the trail.
design: On the commit that locks S5 with [FROM→TO S5: agreed] 3-of-3, run: bd close fizzy-6iv --reason "S5 spec ratified; tags/taggings mirror posture specified". No code changes; no auto-trigger. Closer mints a brief notes entry pointing back to fizzy-h91 lock event.
acceptance_criteria: After S5 lock, bd show fizzy-6iv reports CLOSED with the cited reason; this bead can then close as completed-by-action.
notes: Spec: llm/notes/s5-labels-assignees-spec.md §K. MANUAL on S5 3-of-3 lock; do not wire to anything that closes automatically.

title: S5 F.10 — Integration tests: AssignmentsController flow + Beads sync
description: End-to-end coverage of assignment create/destroy with verification that the Assignment AR callback fires set_assignee with the chronologically-first email. Per spec §I.2.
design: New file test/integration/cards/assignments_flow_test.rb. Stubs Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient.current. POST /:account_id/cards/:id/assignments asserts AR row created and set_assignee("ID", "user@example.com") invoked; DELETE asserts AR row destroyed and set_assignee invoked with next-oldest email or empty string when last assignment removed.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/integration/cards/assignments_flow_test.rb passes; ordering and empty-string clear path both verified via CommandClient mock.

title: S5 F.9 — Integration tests: TaggingsController flow (create/destroy + 422 paths)
description: End-to-end coverage of the rewired tagging endpoints, including normalization rejection (#) and reserved-namespace rejection (fizzy/). Per spec §I.2.
design: New file test/integration/cards/taggings_flow_test.rb. Stubs Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient.current and asserts: POST /:account_id/cards/:id/taggings with title=backend issues add_label("ID", "backend"); POST with title=#Backend returns 422; POST with title=fizzy/board/abc returns 422; DELETE removes via remove_label. Uses fixtures + ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/integration/cards/taggings_flow_test.rb passes; CommandClient mocks verified for both happy and 422 paths.

title: S5 F.8 — Tag deletion job: iterate issues + remove label + delete Tag
description: Implements the admin tag-deletion flow: when an admin deletes a Fizzy Tag, every Beads issue carrying that label must have it removed via remove_label, then the Tag row deletes. Per spec §J.5 / P7 §B.4.
design: New file app/jobs/tag_deletion_job.rb defining TagDeletionJob < ApplicationJob. perform(tag) iterates all Beads issues holding the labels title (via taggings join or Beads list query), calls Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient.current.remove_label(card_id, tag.title) for each, then tag.destroy. Enqueued from a future admin controller; this bead delivers the job class only.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/jobs/tag_deletion_job_test.rb passes; tests assert remove_label invoked once per tagged card, then Tag row deleted; idempotent when label already absent.

title: S5 F.7 — Add Assignment AR callbacks to mirror primary assignee to Beads
description: Implements the Fizzy → Beads assignee mirror: every Assignment create/destroy triggers a re-computation of chronologically-first assignee and a CommandClient set_assignee call. Per spec §F.3.
design: Edit app/models/assignment.rb. Add after_create_commit :sync_primary_assignee_to_beads and after_destroy_commit :sync_primary_assignee_to_beads. Private method reloads the card, takes assignments.order(:created_at).first, extracts identity.email_address (or empty string), and calls Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient.current.set_assignee(card.id, primary_email). Existing within_limit validation stays.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/assignment_test.rb passes; tests assert that creating/destroying an Assignment triggers set_assignee with the chronologically-first assignee email (or empty string when last assignment removed).

title: S5 F.6 — Rewire Cards::TaggingsController#create/destroy to use CommandClient
description: Closes the S2 cross-spec dep fizzy-eq4.9: the controller stops directly creating Tag/Tagging rows and instead delegates to CommandClient.add_label/remove_label, with the S9 poller doing the eventual mirror. Per spec §G.
design: Edit app/controllers/cards/taggings_controller.rb. #create normalizes params[:title] via LabelNormalizer, raises if it starts with fizzy/, calls Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient.current.add_label(@card.id, title), and renders an optimistic tag for the UI. #destroy normalizes and calls remove_label. set_card before_action loads from Current.account.cards. Removes direct toggle_tag_with calls.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/controllers/cards/taggings_controller_test.rb passes; integration tests asserts CommandClient stub receives the expected argv; rubocop clean.

title: S5 F.5 — Add _add_system_label / _remove_system_label private methods
description: Internal-only path for system code (e.g., Board membership writes of fizzy/board/<uuid>) to legitimately write reserved-namespace labels, bypassing the public-method controller-level rejection. Per spec §C.4.
design: Edit app/models/fizzy/beads/command_client.rb. Add private methods _add_system_label(id, label) and _remove_system_label(id, label) that run LabelNormalizer.call but skip the fizzy/ prefix rejection, then invoke! ["update", id, "--add-label"|"--remove-label", normalized]. Callable only via send from internal Fizzy code (Board create/destroy flow); not from user-facing controllers.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/fizzy/beads/command_client_test.rb passes; tests assert send(:_add_system_label, "ID-1", "fizzy/board/abc") yields the correct argv and does NOT raise; methods are not in CommandClient.public_instance_methods.

title: S5 F.4 — Add set_assignee method to CommandClient
description: Exposes the bd update --assignee argv used by the Assignment AR callback to mirror the chronologically-first assignee to Beads. Per spec §C.1 and §F.3.
design: Edit app/models/fizzy/beads/command_client.rb. Add public method set_assignee(id, email_or_nil) that coerces nil to empty string and invoke!s ["update", id, "--assignee", value]. Empty value clears Beads assignee.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/fizzy/beads/command_client_test.rb passes; tests assert set_assignee("ID-1", "user@example.com") yields argv with --assignee user@example.com; set_assignee("ID-1", "") and set_assignee("ID-1", nil) both yield empty value.

title: S5 F.3 — Add label methods to CommandClient (add_label, remove_label, set_labels)
description: Exposes the canonical bd argv for incremental label mutation through the S3 CommandClient surface, with normalization + reserved-namespace rejection at the boundary. Per spec §A.2 and §C.1.
design: Edit app/models/fizzy/beads/command_client.rb (S3-locked surface). Add public methods add_label(id, label), remove_label(id, label), set_labels(id, labels). Each runs LabelNormalizer.call on input; add_label and set_labels raise ArgumentError on fizzy/ prefix. Methods invoke! with argv ["update", id, "--add-label"|"--remove-label"|"--set-labels", ...]; set_labels joins normalized labels with commas.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/fizzy/beads/command_client_test.rb passes; tests assert add_label("ID-1", "Backend") yields argv ["bd", "--actor", "x@y.com", "update", "ID-1", "--add-label", "backend"]; add_label with fizzy/board/abc raises ArgumentError; remove_label and set_labels argv composition verified.

title: S5 F.2 — Implement Fizzy::Beads::ReservedNamespace.violates? shared helper for controllers
description: WHY: §D.2 defense-in-depth requires controller-side rejection of fizzy/-prefixed user input BEFORE invoking CommandClient. Tag model validation was rejected per v1 review feedback because it would block the S9 poller from mirroring legitimate fizzy/board/<uuid> labels. The shared helper centralizes the check.
design: HOW: Create lib/fizzy/beads/reserved_namespace.rb with module-level violates?(label) method using LabelNormalizer + RESERVED_PREFIX_RE = /\Afizzy\//i regex. Used by Cards::TaggingsController#create (and any future label-input surface). NO change to Tag AR model.
acceptance_criteria: Helper module exists; Cards::TaggingsController#create returns 422 when title starts with fizzy/; Tag.create!(title: "fizzy/board/abc") still works (poller path).

title: S5 F.1 — Implement LabelNormalizer + unit tests
description: Single chokepoint for label string normalization, used by every CommandClient label method. Per spec §E, ensures consistency between user input, controller validation, and Beads writes.
design: New file lib/fizzy/beads/label_normalizer.rb defining module Fizzy::Beads::LabelNormalizer with class InvalidLabelError < StandardError and self.call(raw) that strips, downcases, raises on leading # or empty input. Returns the normalized string.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/lib/fizzy/beads/label_normalizer_test.rb passes; tests cover: downcase, strip whitespace, raise InvalidLabelError on leading #, raise InvalidLabelError on empty/whitespace-only input.

title: S5: Labels + assignees spec
description: Fifth Spec round (S-batch). Produces perfect beads for: (a) Beads-canonical labels with bd argv via CommandClient (S3) and Fizzy tags/taggings mirror via S9 poller, (b) assignments sidecar table preserving multi-assignee with sync to Beads issues.assignee, (c) reserved label namespace registry + tag normalization. Inputs: P7 primary, S2 §A.5 + §D.4 (board label namespace + cross-spec dep fizzy-eq4.9), S3 §B.1 CommandClient surface, S4 method-enum precedent, P9 §A.2 mirror doctrine. Drafter: fizzy-claude (alternation). Output: llm/notes/s5-labels-assignees-spec.md design doc + parent epic + child beads + dependency wiring. Closes placeholder fizzy-6iv on lock.
design: Beads labels canonical; Fizzy tags/taggings = MySQL mirror via S9 poller (callback-bypass upsert_all). Writes go through CommandClient.add_label/remove_label/set_labels with bd update --add-label/--remove-label/--set-labels argv. Reserved fizzy/ namespace enforced at controller (shared helper) + CommandClient (defense-in-depth); NOT at Tag model layer (would block poller). LabelNormalizer applies downcase + leading-# reject + strip whitespace at Fizzy write boundary. Labels failing normalization are CLI-only (not mirrored). Assignments sidecar (post-S1 widening) preserves multi-assignee; primary assignee syncs to Beads issues.assignee single-value via AR after_commit callback. TaggingsController + AssignmentsController rewired.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc llm/notes/s5-labels-assignees-spec.md complete with sections A-L per llm/notes/s5-brief.md; parent epic + child beads (~10-14 children); cross-spec deps to S3 (5jt, r4v) and S1 (k48 taggings, h6i assignments); fizzy-6iv placeholder closed on lock; ratified 3-of-3 by [S5: agreed] signals.
notes: Drafter alternation: S1=Claude, S2=Codex, S3=Claude, S4=Codex, S5=Claude, S6=Codex. Brief at llm/notes/s5-brief.md. Reviewers: fizzy-codex (peer), fizzy-gemini (third-lens). Excludes: code change, S3 auth, S4 lifecycle, S2 projection internals, S1 FK migrations, S6 comments, S7 attachments, S8 events, S9 poller internals (S5 specifies WHAT mirrors; S9 specifies HOW). Closes fizzy-6iv placeholder on lock.

title: S4 F.10 — Job tests for entropy defer_until + system actor
description: WHY: Entropy runs out of band and must not leak actor; must pass correct timestamp format.
design: HOW: Add job tests that execute entropy job / Card::Entropic.auto_postpone_all_due with stubbed Open3.capture3 and assert Current.with actor scoping + bd defer --until=<iso8601>.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test job tests pass; asserts no actor leakage across sequential jobs.

title: S4 F.9 — Integration tests for close/reopen and defer flows
description: WHY: Controllers must propagate actor and invoke correct lifecycle bd argv.
design: HOW: Add integration tests for Cards::ClosuresController and Cards::NotNowsController (and column move flow) that stub Open3.capture3 and assert bd close/reopen/defer argv includes --actor current identity.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test integration suite for lifecycle passes; verifies actor propagation + correct subcommand usage.

title: S4 F.8 — Unit tests for lifecycle CommandClient methods
description: WHY: Ensure canonical argv mapping is locked and regression-proof.
design: HOW: Add tests that stub Open3.capture3 and assert argv for close/reopen/defer/undefer/update_status/update_defer_until, including ISO8601 timestamp argument format.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test for CommandClient lifecycle tests passes; failures include helpful argv/stderr.

title: S4 F.5 — Rewire triage/column placement to status updates
description: WHY: Column placement is Beads status-driven (S2); card.column_id can no longer be lifecycle truth.
design: HOW: Update Card::Triageable and Cards::ColumnsController to map selected Column to its columns.beads_status and call CommandClient.update_status. send_back_to_triage becomes reset-to-open (Todo) unless configured otherwise. Preserve board/column ownership checks.
acceptance_criteria: No lifecycle path updates cards.column_id; selecting a column emits bd update --status; board view grouping remains consistent with S2.

title: S4 F.6 — Entropy auto-postpone uses bd defer --until with system actor
description: WHY: Entropy must be implemented as a recurring job that sets defer_until via Beads, with correct actor attribution.
design: HOW: Replace Card::Entropic.auto_postpone_all_due to compute until = Time.current + auto_postpone_period and call CommandClient.defer_issue(id, until: until). Run inside Current.with(actor: SystemActor.email) block per S3. Preserve account/board entropy config logic.
acceptance_criteria: Entropy job defers due cards with correct until timestamp format; uses Current.with block; tests stub bd argv and assert --actor system@... and --until=...

title: S4 F.3 — Rewire close/reopen to Beads and deprecate Closure as truth
description: WHY: closures table must not be source-of-truth; close/reopen must write to Beads and UI must read from Card mirror fields.
design: HOW: Update Card::Closeable and Cards::ClosuresController to call CommandClient lifecycle methods. Replace closed/open scopes and closed_at/closed_by reads to use cards.beads_status + cards.closed_at (+ optional closed_by_actor if/when mirrored). Keep closures table as derived cache only until removed.
acceptance_criteria: No lifecycle path creates/destroys Closure rows as truth; UI close state reflects Beads; tests updated.

title: S4 F.4 — Rewire postpone (Not now) to Beads defer/undefer
description: WHY: NotNow becomes Beads deferred status; card_not_nows and Card::NotNow are removed per P6/S1.
design: HOW: Replace Card::Postponable#postpone and Cards::NotNowsController / Columns::Cards::Drops::NotNowsController to call CommandClient.defer_issue (bd defer) instead of creating Card::NotNow. Manual postpone uses no --until; entropy uses until. Resume uses CommandClient.undefer_issue and optional restore_status.
acceptance_criteria: No writes to card_not_nows remain; postpone results in status deferred; undefer clears defer_until; tests updated.

title: S4 F.1 — Add lifecycle methods to CommandClient (close/reopen/defer/undefer/status)
description: WHY: All lifecycle actions must map to canonical bd argv via CommandClient (S3).
design: HOW: Extend app/models/fizzy/beads/command_client.rb with methods: update_status, close_issue (bd close), reopen_issue (bd reopen + optional restore_status via bd update), defer_issue (bd defer + optional until), undefer_issue (bd undefer + optional restore_status), update_defer_until (bd update --defer). Use explicit subcommands by default. Ensure all calls prefix bd --actor. No ENV.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover argv composition for each method; errors raise CommandError; methods accept custom status strings.

title: S4 F.2 — Add Card mirror lifecycle columns (closed_at, defer_until, close_reason)
description: WHY: Closure deprecation and entropy require lifecycle read state in MySQL Card mirror (no cross-DB reads).
design: HOW: Migration adds cards.closed_at (datetime), cards.defer_until (datetime), cards.close_reason (text or string), with indexes where needed. These are mirrored from Beads issues fields by the S9 poller (placeholder fizzy-1iz).
acceptance_criteria: db:migrate adds columns; schema.rb matches; reads can use card.closed_at/defer_until without touching closures; bin/ci passes.

title: S4: Lifecycle + entropy spec
description: Fourth Spec round (S-batch). Produces perfect beads for the lifecycle adapter mapping every Fizzy lifecycle action (close/reopen/postpone/triage/resume) to bd argv via CommandClient (S3), deprecating the Closure model as source-of-truth (Beads is SoT), and implementing entropy as a recurring job using Current.with(actor: SystemActor.email) per S3 §D.3. Inputs: P6 (lifecycle adapter) primary, S3 §B CommandClient surface, S2 §B.2 column-status consistency. Drafter: fizzy-codex (alternation). Output: llm/notes/s4-lifecycle-entropy-spec.md design doc + parent epic + child beads + dependency wiring.
design: Lifecycle adapter on top of locked CommandClient. Canonical CLI argv table per action. Closure deprecation: read closed_at + attribution from Beads issues+events instead of Fizzy closures table. Entropy: AutoPostponeJob rewrite using Current.with block form, computing defer_until from board/account entropy windows, calling bd update --defer-until. Triage/in-progress moves: Cards::ColumnsController calls bd update --status (NOT cards.column_id write per S2). Reopen: restore prior status via metadata per P6 §G.2.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc llm/notes/s4-lifecycle-entropy-spec.md complete with sections A-J per llm/notes/s4-brief.md; parent epic + child beads (~10-16 children); cross-spec deps to S3 (fizzy-5jt, fizzy-r4v, fizzy-1s3, fizzy-du0) and S1 (fizzy-m6r, fizzy-flu); ratified 3-of-3 by [S4: agreed] signals.
notes: Drafter alternation: S1=Claude, S2=Codex, S3=Claude, S4=Codex, S5=Claude. Brief at llm/notes/s4-brief.md. Reviewers: fizzy-claude (peer), fizzy-gemini (third-lens). Excludes: code change, S3 auth, S2 projection, S1 FK migrations, S5 labels, S6 comments, S7 attachments, S8 events feed, S9 search/poller. Build on locked S3 CommandClient surface.

title: S3 F.10 — Wire S2 controllers (fizzy-eq4.8) to CommandClient.current — unblock S2 implementation
description: Closes the loop with S2 — the actual controller call sites that perform Beads writes need to dispatch through CommandClient.current. Satisfies §C.3 — wires Cards::BoardsController#update (and any other S2-claimed controller) to use the new dispatch primitive, unblocking S2 implementation children.
design: In each S2-claimed Beads-touching controller action (Cards::BoardsController#update per S2 §D.5; siblings as enumerated by S2), replace any direct shell-out or placeholder with Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient.current.<method>(...). The current scope of this bead is just Cards::BoardsController#update (fizzy-eq4.8); fizzy-eq4.9 (TaggingsController) is owned by S5/S2 sibling work. Keep controllers thin — push any meaningful logic into models per STYLE.md vanilla-Rails guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/controllers/cards/boards_controller_test.rb. Asserts move-card-between-boards path invokes CommandClient.current with expected argv (Open3.capture3 stubbed); unauthenticated request would raise MissingActorError. fizzy-eq4.8 can now resume implementation against this primitive.

title: S3 F.9 — Job tests: BeadsActorTenanted serialize/restore + CommandClient.current in jobs
description: Verifies actor context survives the request→job boundary in both serialize and execute phases. Satisfies §H.3 — the async propagation contract.
design: Create test/jobs/beads_actor_tenanted_test.rb. Use Solid Queue test adapter to run jobs synchronously. Test 1: enqueue a job inside Current.with(actor: "x@y.com") block; assert job_data["beads_actor"] == "x@y.com". Test 2: deserialize+perform restores Current.actor to "x@y.com" inside the perform block. Test 3: a job that calls Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient.current.invoke!(...) with stubbed Open3 captures argv showing --actor x@y.com. Test 4: job enqueued without Current.actor set passes through (no actor restoration), and a CommandClient.current call inside raises MissingActorError.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/jobs/beads_actor_tenanted_test.rb — all four scenarios pass; serialize-key roundtrips the captured actor; restore happens inside around_perform.

title: S3 F.8 — Integration tests: web cookie + bearer-token actor propagation
description: Verifies the full request→CommandClient pathway under both auth modes so we know argv carries the right actor end-to-end. Satisfies §H.2 — the controller-level propagation contract.
design: Create test/integration/beads_actor_propagation_test.rb. Stub Open3.capture3 to capture argv. Test 1: authenticated cookie session for david@example.com hits a Beads-touching controller, asserts captured argv includes --actor david@example.com. Test 2: bearer-token request with a token issued to a fixture Identity, asserts captured argv includes --actor <token-identity-email>. Test 3: hits an allow_unauthenticated_access controller path that erroneously calls CommandClient.current, asserts MissingActorError surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/integration/beads_actor_propagation_test.rb — all three scenarios pass; the stub captured argv exactly matches the expected --actor value per case.

title: S3 F.7 — Unit tests: CommandClient + Current + SystemActor
description: Pins the unit-level contract of the three foundational classes so regressions surface immediately. Satisfies §H.1 — the canonical unit test trio.
design: Create three test files. test/models/fizzy/beads/command_client_test.rb: stubs Open3.capture3, asserts argv composition includes --actor as element [1..2]; covers MissingActorError on nil/empty; CommandError on non-zero exit (with argv+stderr); .for(Identity) extracts email; .for(String) passes through; .for(nil) raises; .current reads Current.actor and raises if unset. test/models/current_test.rb: covers identity= setter populating actor; direct Current.actor= write; per-thread isolation via Thread.new + Current.with. test/models/system_actor_test.rb: covers .email format, .identity returns the singleton row, .user returns the system-role User; missing install_hostname config raises.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/models/fizzy/beads/command_client_test.rb test/models/current_test.rb test/models/system_actor_test.rb — all pass. Coverage: every assertion enumerated in §H.1 has a corresponding test method.

title: S3 F.6 — BeadsActorTenanted concern + prepend at all four real anchors (ApplicationJob + 3 initializer prepends)
description: Propagates Current.actor across the request→job boundary so async Beads writes carry correct attribution (Gemini prior #3). Satisfies §D.1, §D.2 — mirrors AccountTenanted exactly with serialize/deserialize/around_perform.
design: Create app/jobs/concerns/beads_actor_tenanted.rb mirroring AccountTenanted. Prepend at the four real code anchors: app/jobs/application_job.rb (after existing prepend AccountTenanted line), and config/initializers/active_job.rb for ActionMailer::MailDeliveryJob, Turbo::Streams::ActionBroadcastJob, Turbo::Streams::BroadcastJob, Turbo::Streams::BroadcastStreamJob. There is no FizzyActiveJobExtensions constant despite docs referencing it. Use Current.with(actor: ...) block form inside around_perform to prevent leak between jobs on the same worker thread.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/jobs/concerns/beads_actor_tenanted_test.rb. Asserts a job enqueued under Current.with(actor: "x@y.com") serializes "beads_actor" => "x@y.com"; deserialize+perform restores Current.actor to that value; CommandClient.current inside perform sees the right actor.

title: S3 F.5 — ApplicationController before_action :set_current_actor (defense-in-depth)
description: Belt-and-braces guarantee that Current.actor is populated for any authenticated request even if some path bypassed the Current.identity= setter. Satisfies §C.1, §C.2 — adds the before_action that runs after require_authentication.
design: Edit app/controllers/concerns/authentication.rb (or app/controllers/application_controller.rb if cleaner). Add before_action :set_current_actor, if: :authenticated? after require_authentication in the include chain. Define private set_current_actor that does Current.actor = Current.identity&.email_address || SystemActor.email. Verify ordering so resume_session / authenticate_by_bearer_token have already populated Current.identity.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/controllers/. Asserts authenticated requests leave Current.actor populated to the session identitys email; bearer-token requests populate it to the token-Identitys email; allow_unauthenticated_access paths leave Current.actor unset (and any Beads call would loudly raise MissingActorError).

title: S3 F.4 — Implement Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient (#invoke!, .for, .current, errors)
description: Ships the dispatch primitive every Beads-touching write goes through. Satisfies §B.1, §B.2, §B.4 — locks the class shape with explicit actor: kwarg (Gemini prior #2: no anonymous writes; raise on missing) and bans ENV-hash forms.
design: Create app/models/fizzy/beads/command_client.rb. Define MissingActorError < StandardError and CommandError < StandardError (with attr_reader :argv, :status, :stderr and a constructor that builds an informative message). Class methods: .for(identity_or_actor) normalizes Identity→email/String→passthrough/nil→raise; .current reads Current.actor or raises MissingActorError. Instance: initialize(actor:, bd_bin: "bd") raising on nil/empty actor; private #invoke!(argv) builds [@bd_bin, "--actor", @actor, *argv] and runs Open3.capture3 with NO env hash, raising CommandError on non-zero exit. Public command surface methods are intentionally left to S4/S5/S6.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/models/fizzy/beads/command_client_test.rb. Asserts argv composition stubs Open3.capture3 to capture [bd, --actor, x@y.com, ...]; .for(nil) raises MissingActorError; .current with unset Current.actor raises MissingActorError; non-zero exit raises CommandError carrying argv+stderr.

title: S3 F.3 — Migration: bootstrap system Identity + system User at install
description: Ensures the singleton system Identity + system User exist before any recurring job or Beads write needs them. Satisfies §F.3 (a) — ships the canonical install-time data migration so SystemActor.identity / SystemActor.user always resolve.
design: Add a Rails data migration db/migrate/<timestamp>_bootstrap_system_actor.rb that, in change/up, idempotently creates the system Identity (email_address: SystemActor.email, auto-confirmed) and a paired User (role: :system, name: "Fizzy System") for each existing Account. Use find_or_create_by! to remain re-runnable. Verify Identity#confirmable? handling and User#setup? compatibility with the system role per §F.4.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails db:migrate then bin/rails test test/models/system_actor_test.rb. Asserts the system Identity row exists post-migration; the linked User has role: :system, name: "Fizzy System"; re-running the migration is a no-op (idempotent).

title: S3 F.2 — Implement SystemActor accessor + install_hostname config
description: Provides a stable code-side accessor for the system actor email so we never hardcode it in 50 places. Satisfies §F.2 — defines SystemActor.email/identity/user and the Rails.application.config.x.fizzy.install_hostname config plumbing.
design: Create app/models/system_actor.rb implementing class methods .identity (Identity.find_by!(email_address: email)), .user (memoized identity.users.find_by!(role: :system)), .email ("system@" + install_hostname), and .install_hostname (reads Rails.application.config.x.fizzy.install_hostname or raises). Add config/initializers/fizzy.rb (or extend config/application.rb) to set Rails.application.config.x.fizzy.install_hostname per environment (e.g. app.fizzy.localhost in development/test).
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/models/system_actor_test.rb. Asserts SystemActor.email returns "system@app.fizzy.localhost" in test env; SystemActor.identity returns the singleton Identity row; SystemActor.user returns User with role: :system; missing config raises a clear error.

title: S3 F.1 — Add :actor to Current + populate via identity= setter
description: Foundational change so all request/job code paths have a single canonical actor email accessible via Current.actor. Satisfies §A.5 — adds :actor to the Current attribute list and wires the identity= setter to derive Current.actor from Identity.email_address automatically (Gemini prior #1: strict derivation from Identity).
design: Edit app/models/current.rb. Add :actor to the existing attribute list alongside :session, :user, :identity, :account. In the existing identity= setter (override of super), after the existing user assignment branch, also assign self.actor = identity.email_address when identity is present. Preserve existing session= behavior (which delegates to identity=). Leave Current.actor= as a plain unmediated string write so system-job paths can set it directly without an Identity.
acceptance_criteria: Run bin/rails test test/models/current_test.rb. New cases assert: (1) setting Current.identity = identities(:david) sets Current.actor to davids email_address; (2) Current.actor = "x@y.com" works as a direct string write; (3) Current.with(actor: ...) block scope properly isolates per-thread.

title: S3: Auth + actor propagation spec
description: Third Spec round (S-batch). Produces perfect beads for the actor-propagation system that lets every Beads-touching write carry the canonical actor identifier (Identity email per P5 §A.5) all the way from controller to job to bd --actor <email> argv flag, without leaking actor state across requests/threads or ENV. Inputs: P5 (auth bridging) primary, P3 §A.3 (CommandClient sketch), S2 §D.5 (controllers that will use CommandClient). Drafter: fizzy-claude (alternation). Output: llm/notes/s3-auth-actor-propagation-spec.md design doc + parent epic bead + child task beads + dependency wiring.
design: Current.actor module (request- and job-scoped, thread-safe, no global). Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient class with explicit actor: kwarg, composes bd --actor <email> argv prefix. ApplicationController before_action sets Current.actor from Current.user.identity.email. ActiveJob extension serializes/restores Current.actor (parallel to existing Current.account pattern). System-actor identity bootstrapped at install. Bearer-token API future hook present but not implemented. Failure modes: raise on missing actor (no silent fallback).
acceptance_criteria: Design doc llm/notes/s3-auth-actor-propagation-spec.md complete with §A-§K per llm/notes/s3-brief.md; parent epic bead + child task beads created (one per atomic unit, ~8-14 children); cross-spec deps to S2 children where Beads-touching controllers exist; ratified 3-of-3 by [S3: agreed] signals.
notes: Drafter alternation: S1=Claude, S2=Codex, S3=Claude, S4=Codex. Brief at llm/notes/s3-brief.md. Reviewers: fizzy-codex (peer), fizzy-gemini (third-lens). Excludes: login UX (P5 locked), board projection (S2 locked), lifecycle CLI argv (S4), label CLI argv (S5), bearer-token internals (P5 §B v2+).

title: S2 F.13 — System tests: board projection + access control + move board/column
description: WHY: Projection rewires core UX; tests must prevent regressions and prove no cross-DB joins.
design: HOW: Add system tests covering: board show groups cards by beads_status; moving boards updates membership; access revoke hides cards; pinned overlay. Use Capybara for now per test-discipline.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test:system passes; tests fail if cards.board_id/column_id paths regress.

title: S2 F.11 — Pins overlay remains functional with board label membership
description: WHY: Pinned is an overlay section (P4 §C.3); pins are Fizzy-side and must work after card_id becomes varchar.
design: HOW: Ensure pin queries and pin tray broadcasting still work when cards are projected; ensure CardScoped resolves correct route key.
acceptance_criteria: Pin/unpin works; pinned section shows pinned cards for current board; no broken broadcasts.

title: S2 F.12 — Specify and implement poller drift correction for single-board invariant (blocked on S9)
description: WHY: Users can create drift by manual bd label edits; poller must correct to preserve Fizzy 1-board mental model (Gemini prior #2).
design: HOW: Add requirement and stub implementation hook in poller to detect multiple fizzy/board/* labels and deterministically pick one. Final algorithm implemented in I-S9.
acceptance_criteria: Spec defines drift cases + correction rule; implementation bead exists and is clearly blocked on S9 poller work.

title: S2 F.10 — Rewrite board access cleanup queries (Board::Accessible) to be label-based
description: WHY: Access revoke cleanup currently joins cards.board_id (will be removed). Must preserve multi-user privacy in single-tenant.
design: HOW: Rewrite mentions_for_user and notifications_for_user to join via taggings/tags membership_label instead of cards.board_id. Preserve Card and Comment paths.
acceptance_criteria: Revoking board access deletes mentions/notifications/pins/watches for cards on that board using label-based joins; no references to cards.board_id remain.

title: S2 F.9 — Rewrite Cards::TaggingsController to mutate Beads labels (bd update --add-label/--remove-label)
description: WHY: Tags are canonical in Beads; UI tag toggles must write via bd CLI and reserve fizzy/* system labels.
design: HOW: Replace @card.toggle_tag_with with CommandClient.add_label/remove_label. Hide system labels (fizzy/*) from user selection and prevent adding board labels manually.
acceptance_criteria: Tag toggle performs bd write; reserved prefixes enforced; UI tag list excludes board/system labels.

title: S2 F.7 — Rewrite BoardsController#show to use projector (replaces awaiting_triage + column_id)
description: WHY: Current show path relies on board.cards.awaiting_triage (column_id). Fork uses label membership + beads_status.
design: HOW: Replace show_columns/show_filtered_cards flows to use projector for kanban/list; keep filter path but ensure it compiles to Card mirror (S9).
acceptance_criteria: Board show renders with projector; no reliance on Card.column/board_id; list+kanban both available per board.

title: S2 F.8 — Rewrite Cards::BoardsController update to move boards via bd label writes
description: WHY: Moving a card between boards must enforce single-board label invariant (P4 §A.4) and write through bd CLI (P3/P5).
design: HOW: Replace @card.move_to(@board) with CommandClient.move_to_board(card_beads_id, board.membership_label), which removes existing fizzy/board/* labels and adds the target label.
acceptance_criteria: Moving card between boards updates Beads labels via bd update flags; invariant enforced; UI reflects membership after projection sync.

title: S2 F.5 — Rewire Column projection model (no has_many :cards; status+label rules)
description: WHY: Columns are projection metadata; placement comes from cards.beads_status + optional match_label (P4 §B.1).
design: HOW: Remove Column has_many :cards and touch callbacks; define Column#matches?(card) via beads_status + optional label. Column ordering stays columns.position; move_left/right controllers remain.
acceptance_criteria: Column model supports beads_status+match_label rules; no nullify cards on column destroy; column reorder endpoints still function.

title: S2 F.6 — Implement board show query object (group cards into columns; Kanban+List)
description: WHY: BoardsController#show must render Kanban+List from MySQL-only Card mirror substrate (Gemini prior #1).
design: HOW: Introduce a BoardProjector/query object that takes board + columns and returns per-column card relations + pinned overlay relation. All computed from Card + Tagging + Tag + Pin; no cross-DB joins. Must treat beads_status='pinned' as overlay (excluded from columns by default). Must ensure unknown beads_status stays visible (fallback to Todo/open unless custom_statuses categorization is available via projection).
acceptance_criteria: Given a board, projector returns correct columns->cards grouping; list view returns same set; beads_status='pinned' cards appear in pinned overlay and do not disappear; unknown/custom statuses remain visible via fallback; queries are explainable and index-backed.

title: S2 F.3 — Implement Board#membership_label + reserved board-label namespace
description: WHY: Board membership is encoded as Beads labels in reserved namespace fizzy/board/<uuid> (P4 §A.5). Must be generated consistently for reads/writes.
design: HOW: Add Board#membership_label returning "fizzy/board/#{id}"; add helpers to detect board-label namespace. Ensure UI hides system labels by prefix.
acceptance_criteria: Board#membership_label stable; system label prefix is recognized; user tag UI hides board labels.

title: S2 F.4 — Rewire Board.cards projection to label-based membership (no cards.board_id)
description: WHY: Board membership is Beads label, projected into MySQL via Tag/Tagging. Must remove has_many :cards and compute membership from taggings to satisfy no cross-DB joins.
design: HOW: Replace Board::Cards has_many :cards with computed relation: Card.joins(taggings: :tag).where(tags.title==membership_label). Update any Board code relying on cards.board_id.
acceptance_criteria: Board#cards returns correct cards from Tagging mirror; destroying board does not destroy cards; no usage of cards.board_id remains in board projection paths.

title: S2 F.2 — Seed default columns on board create (Todo/Doing/Blocked/Not now/Done)
description: WHY: New boards must have a consistent out-of-box workflow with crisp status mapping (Gemini prior #3).
design: HOW: On Board create (or in after_create), create 5 Column rows with beads_status=open/in_progress/blocked/deferred/closed, names per P4, positions 1..5. Ensure idempotent reseed for legacy boards.
acceptance_criteria: Creating a board results in 5 columns with correct beads_status + ordering; no duplicates on repeated runs; tests cover seeding.

title: S2 F.1 — Add columns.beads_status + columns.match_label (migration)
description: WHY: Columns must map Beads status→UI placement; labels allow optional custom columns without abandoning status backbone (P4 §B.1-§C.2).
design: HOW: Add columns.beads_status (string(32) NOT NULL) + columns.match_label (string, null) + indexes. Seed/backfill existing columns. No Beads schema changes.
acceptance_criteria: db:migrate adds columns + indexes; db:rollback removes; schema.rb matches; bin/ci passes.

Controllers: Boards/Columns/Access REST surface; writes that touch Beads issue state go through bd CLI with --actor flag; pure Fizzy-side concerns (Access) stay AR.
